'''Baker Squadron''' was a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Dimok government]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. ''Baker 2'' was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
